description: This file defines a functional interface `JmsExceptionThrowingBiConsumer` that extends the standard Java `BiConsumer` with additional functionality for handling JMS exceptions. It provides a method to accept a JMS Message and a String (generic type T) and throw JMSException. It also includes a static method to wrap such consumers, converting checked JMSExceptions into unchecked JMSRuntimeExceptions.

classes.name: JmsExceptionThrowingBiConsumer
classes.description: A functional interface similar to BiConsumer that accepts a JMS Message and a value, and potentially throws a JMSException.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Performs an operation on a JMS Message and a value of type T, throwing JMSException if necessary.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Converts a JmsExceptionThrowingBiConsumer into a standard BiConsumer by wrapping JMSExceptions into JMSRuntimeExceptions.
